$comment: Bundle-size gate. Budgets are gzipped KB per logical entrypoint — see scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs. The content script is injected into every LLM tab, so it gets the tightest scrutiny. Bump a budget only with a deliberate reason in the commit.

entries.name: content-script
entries.$reason: Bumped 65->90 for the input-action-bar change: the bar is a content-script shadow-DOM overlay (design D-2), so the content bundle now legitimately carries Preact + the floating/dialog primitives (useFloating, Zag dialog) it mounts. WXT inlines content-script deps, so lazy-loading would not reliably trim this entry.
